mapper.select: select VOUCHERNUM, AFFIRMDATE, AFFIRMUSER, AUDITDATE, AUDITMSG, AUDITUSER, IMPORTEDDATE, IMPORTEDUSER, ISAUDIT, ISAUDITMSGVALID, JOURNALSOURCECODE, LEDGERDATE, MANAGERGROUPCODE, SETTLEMENTDATE, STAMPDATE, STAMPUSER, TANUM, TRADEDATE, PORTFOLIONUM from voucher where VOUCHERNUM = #{vouchernum,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.insert: insert into voucher ( VOUCHERNUM, AFFIRMDATE, AFFIRMUSER, AUDITDATE, AUDITMSG, AUDITUSER, IMPORTEDDATE, IMPORTEDUSER, ISAUDIT, ISAUDITMSGVALID, JOURNALSOURCECODE, LEDGERDATE, MANAGERGROUPCODE, SETTLEMENTDATE, STAMPDATE, STAMPUSER, TANUM, TRADEDATE, PORTFOLIONUM ) values( #{vouchernum,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{affirmDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{affirmUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{auditDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{auditMsg,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{auditUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{importedDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{importedUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{isAudit,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{isAuditMsgValid,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{journalSourceCode,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{ledgerDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{managerGroupCode,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{settlementDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{stampDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{stampUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{taNum,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{tradeDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{portfolio,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.update: update voucher set VOUCHERNUM = #{vouchernum,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, AFFIRMDATE = #{affirmDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, AFFIRMUSER = #{affirmUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, AUDITDATE = #{auditDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, AUDITMSG = #{auditMsg,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, AUDITUSER = #{auditUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, IMPORTEDDATE = #{importedDate,jdbcType=DATE}, IMPORTEDUSER = #{importedUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ISAUDIT = #{isAudit,jdbcType=INTEGER}, ISAUDITMSGVALID = #{isAuditMsgValid,jdbcType=INTEGER}, JOURNALSOURCECODE = #{journalSourceCode,jdbcType=INTEGER}, LEDGERDATE = #{ledgerDate,jdbcType=DATE}, MANAGERGROUPCODE = #{managerGroupCode,jdbcType=INTEGER}, SETTLEMENTDATE = #{settlementDate,jdbcType=DATE}, STAMPDATE = #{stampDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, STAMPUSER = #{stampUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TANUM = #{taNum,jdbcType=INTEGER}, TRADEDATE = #{tradeDate,jdbcType=DATE}, PORTFOLIONUM = #{portfolio,jdbcType=VARCHAR} where VOUCHERNUM = #{vouchernum,jdbcType=INTEGER}
mapper.select: select v.vouchernum as vouchernum, v.LEDGERDATE as ledgerDate, vd.ACCOUNTNUM as acctnum, coa.ACCNTNAME as acctname, vd.DESCRIPTION as desciption, vd.DR_LOCAL as drLocal, vd.CR_LOCAL as crLocal, vd.DR_FUNC as drFunc, vd.CR_FUNC as crFunc, round(vd.AMOUNT,2) as amount, v.JOURNALSOURCECODE as journalCode, po.port_name as portname, vd.SECURITYID as secid from voucher v,voucherdetails vd, coaa coa, portfolio_hdr po where v.vouchernum=vd.vouchernum and v.portfolionum=po.portfolio and v.portfolionum=#{portnum} and v.ledgerDate=#{ledgerDate} and vd.chartnum=coa.chartnumber and vd.ACCOUNTNUM=coa.accntnum order by v.vouchernum asc
select nvl(count(v.vouchernum),0) from Voucher v where v.portfolionum=#{portNum} and v.ledgerDate=#{journalDate} and v.journalSourceCode=#{journalType}
select vouchernum from Voucher where tanum=#{tanum} and journalSourceCode=#{journalType} and rownum=1
select count(vouchernum) from Voucher where portfolionum=#{portnum}
select nvl(max(vr.vouchernum),0) from Voucher vr where vr.taNum=#{tanum}
